stopping_behavior.rationale: The only P0 slot (objective) was explicitly confirmed before READY_TO_MODEL; the sole remaining item (H2) is a P2 boundary detail, so stopping was appropriate.

summary: The agent cleanly resolved the critical objective slot and other core modeling details, and although its coverage of the boat/train constraint came only via a vague catch-all question (the constraint being volunteered by the simulator), that slot is low-severity and does not undermine stopping appropriateness.
